# apple_build_bundles (Data Source)

Lists the bundles of a build: the app, and the App Clip and watch app it contains. An App Clip's bundle takes `apple_beta_app_clip_invocation` and `data.apple_app_clip_domain_status`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_build_bundles" "latest" {
  build_id = data.apple_build.latest.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `build_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the build; see `data.apple_build`.

### Read-Only

- `build_bundles` (Attributes List) The bundles. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--build_bundles))

<a id="nestedatt--build_bundles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `build_bundles`

Read-Only:

- `bundle_id` (String) Bundle identifier, e.g. `com.example.app.Clip`.
- `bundle_type` (String) Kind of bundle: `APP`, `APP_CLIP`, `WATCH_APP`.
- `file_name` (String) File name of the bundle.
- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the build bundle.
